subject: HISTORY
description: ICSE 10th History: Revolt of 1857, Early Nationalists, Assertive Phase, Muslim League, Mahatma Gandhi

questions.question: What was the immediate cause of the Great Revolt of 1857?
questions.explanation: The introduction of the Enfield rifle cartridges greased with cow and pig fat triggered the uprising.

questions.question: Who presided over the very first session of the Indian National Congress in 1885?
questions.explanation: W.C. Bonnerjee was the President of the 1st INC session held at Gokuldas Tejpal College in Bombay.

questions.question: Who authored the famous book 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India' proposing the Drain Theory?
questions.explanation: Dadabhai Naoroji (Grand Old Man of India) expounded the Drain of Wealth theory.

questions.question: Which tragic event prompted Mahatma Gandhi to withdraw the Non-Cooperation Movement in 1922?
questions.explanation: Violent clash at Chauri Chaura police station in Gorakhpur led Gandhi to suspend Non-Cooperation.

questions.question: The historic Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) was undertaken by Gandhiji in which year?
questions.explanation: Gandhiji commenced the Dandi March on March 12, 1930, marking the Civil Disobedience Movement.
